name: get-wechat-history
description: Read compact local WeChat history through a focused read-only MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Configures and diagnoses the local WeChat history reader, reads known conversations directly as compact AI rows, finds ambiguous conversations, reads recent messages across chats, creates fixed machine snapshots for long reads, exports explicit requests, and decodes requested image messages.
interface.defaultPrompt: For a known contact, group, or chat_id call read_conversation directly. Use find_conversations only for ambiguous names, and use read_recent_across_chats only for cross-chat recency. Default to compact AI rows; use records for evidence and create_snapshot for long fixed reads.
